name: Zork working-name and trademark review

conditions: Do not revive Zork Voice as the public brand; ADR-0028 retires that development working title in favor of STTork.
Complete a qualified name and trademark review or rename the project before a promoted public release.
Do not use third-party logos, trade dress, packaging, or language implying sponsorship or endorsement.

notes: The upstream source-code license expressly does not grant trademark or brand rights.
This record documents an unresolved rights gate; it does not authorize trademark use.
ADR-0028 resolves this Zork-brand boundary by renaming the project STTork. This record remains blocked because it still does not authorize Zork Voice as a brand.
